title: Milestone 12 — Low-End Optimization Before vs After Comparison Ledger

device_environment.physical_device_limitation: Physical low-end device is unavailable on host. Validated on emulator under controlled stress and memory pressure.

optimizations_implemented.purpose: Listens to PowerManager thermal callbacks & battery temperature. Dynamically adjusts render FPS (30 -> 24 -> 20 -> 15) and encoder bitrate (1200 -> 900 -> 700 -> 500 kbps) to prevent thermal runaway.
Implements ComponentCallbacks2 onTrimMemory. Automatically prunes inactive bitmap caches, evicts 50% cache on RUNNING_LOW and 100% on RUNNING_CRITICAL to eliminate OOM risk.
Monitors render frame times. Throttles frame presentation when render latency exceeds 32ms, preventing queue backlog and GPU stalls on constrained processors.
Auto-classifies hardware tier (LOW_END, MID_RANGE, FLAGSHIP) based on total RAM, CPU core count, and isLowRamDevice flag, tailoring streaming defaults.
